name: optcatalog_emit_crater_impact_event
description: OptCatalog::EmitCraterImpactEvent builds and dispatches a crater event for terrain-deforming hit nodes.
known_limits: The smoke target covers the hit-node terrain flag gate, crater relay rejection, accepted relay dispatch into crater InstanceEvent cleanup, radius-mode execution, and vertex-merge epsilon restoration; success-side crater geometry persistence remains covered through accepted zDEClient crater feature targets.
tier S verification is deferred to the coherent OptCatalog/zDEClient crater source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4b0710 validates ECX as OptCatalogEntryDef*, EDX as OptCatalogHitEventPartial*, hitNode flag mask 0x10000 gate, InitEventTemplateDefaults call, surfaceRef-to-craterMaterialSlot copy, hitPos-to-center copy, fixed radius clamp against g_OptCatalogMaxCraterRadius, random radius from craterRadiusBase plus (rand() * craterRadiusRandomRange >> 15), damageOwnerNode stack argument copy, and return of 1 only when InstanceEventMaybeRelay returns 0.

The native OptCatalog smoke verifies unflagged hit nodes do not call the crater relay, flagged hit nodes build enough event state to reach the accepted crater relay path, relay rejection returns 0, accepted relay dispatch reaches InstanceEvent failure cleanup, and both radius branches leave vertex-merge epsilon restored.
